<thought>From the 13C NMR data, low‑field signals typical for methyl carbons appear around 26–27 ppm. The spectrum shows peaks at 26.90 ppm (appearing twice, indicating two equivalent CH₃ groups) and 26.18 ppm (one CH₃ group). No other methyl‑type signals are present. Therefore the molecule contains a total of three CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
